Is that what you mean?

    The picture is our own model.

    Something comes in from outside and lands on one point on the ring. That point is one place in your body, and it answers. The answer runs in along a line, the way a nerve carries a signal. It crosses the middle and spreads back out until the whole ring has felt it. Each time round, the line pulls tighter and the answer comes quicker. On the last pass nothing comes in, and it runs anyway. It is a picture of a model, and it measures nothing.

    Patterns connect.

    What starts in childhood shows up in youth, adulthood and professional life.

    Atuned looks for the connections.

    The outer ring is the 112 addresses, coloured by the part of the body each one belongs to. The points inside are patterns. Each line shows where a pattern pulls. A tighter line, with quicker pulses, pulls harder.

    Seven colours, seven seats, from the base of the spine to the top of the head. A seat is one part of the body a pattern can settle in. The fine lines are nerves. The lit seat is where a pattern sits.
